summary.text: Melissa Litchfield is the incumbent Republican candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Rockingham 32, in the November 3, 2026 general election. She has represented Rockingham 32 since December 2024 and previously served in the House from 2020 to 2022 representing Rockingham 11, according to Ballotpedia.

paragraphs.text: Litchfield lives in Brentwood, New Hampshire.
She graduated from West Boylston Senior High School and earned a B.A. in accounting from Assumption University in 1993.
Her career experience includes working as an underwriting consultant with Merrill Lynch and a senior underwriter with Paul Revere Insurance, Berkshire Life, and Liberty Mutual.
In the 2021-2022 session she was assigned to the Children and Family Law Committee.
